run_dense_eval_hybrid: run the AdsorbML dense evaluation script to compute hybrid ML+DFT success rates at varying top-k values
run_dense_eval_ml_success: run the AdsorbML dense evaluation script with --ml-success to compute ML-only validated success rates
compute_hybrid_success: compute AdsorbML hybrid success rates by comparing top-k ML predicted energies against ground truth DFT energies
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates where ML predictions must be within 0.1 eV of DFT energy
filter_ml_data: filter ML data by setting missing systems or configurations to high energy values to ensure failure cases in evaluation
